question: What thumb placement defines the seal known as kṣobhiṇī in this teaching?
premises: The thumbs are placed at the middle joint of the little fingers.
This configuration is given a specific name.
The name of the seal is kṣobhiṇī.
inference: Placing the thumbs at the middle joint of the little fingers forms the kṣobhiṇī seal.
plain_english: When the thumbs are placed at the middle joint of the little fingers, it is considered the kṣobhiṇī seal.
